description:
User ruling 2026-11-18 (relayed by Make Distiller Fast, verbatim: "delegate the map building, slicing, struct field work to the Optimize agent"). Builder: Optimize. Source: MDF distiller profile at develop 2eff1dec2 (bench, sample 1 ms for 2 s from 0.4 s in, 1,498 samples of a 2.84 s run, inclusive shares, one run; raw: bench distill-hunt/prof.j.base.txt).

fz_map_put_int / _ref / _atom = 16.3% (244 samples), reached from JSON object building (each of 215k lines is an object with nested objects). Inside: map_put_slot self 58; decoding and validating words (AnyValueRef::storage_raw 37, AnyValue::decode_parts 28, map_slot 8) = 73 (~30%); finding the key position (map_key_position 28, TermComparator::compare 22, memcmp 9, bitstring_cmp 8) = 67 (~27%); allocation 7.

Measure first: instructions per fz_map_put on a probe that builds a 6-key map a million times, and the cost of a put into an N-key map as N grows. Then a proposal from the numbers.
title: A map insert decodes each slot it visits once
